title: v6 FAQ: Variety, model variants and Max Mode
reported_observation: Suno documents v6 as its reliable flagship, v6-wild as less predictable and more exploratory, and v6-mini as the faster free model. Its FAQ says Variety adjusts or updates style prompts and suggests Variety 0 when retaining full control of style tags is desired.
creator_interpretation: Visible style text may be transformed or augmented by a product setting before model generation. Model family, Variety and Max Mode are confounds to log.
our_hypothesis: The Variety setting may alter the effective prompt conditioning; this creates a direct, testable product-level transformation variable. Its exact implementation is not disclosed.
